limitations: Original shaders, postprocessing and light response are not fully ported.
MonoBehaviour data and skeletal bindings are preserved; scene-specific runtime behavior is ported selectively.
LevelEnclosed and LevelSlideTraps have dedicated behavior adapters; levels 4-10 currently use imported geometry/colliders with shared FFA runtime.
Animation controllers, original particles and audio callbacks are not yet reproduced at full frame parity.
Static batched renderers require source submesh selection before visual parity can be asserted.
